label: Homicides Since Sep 9, 2024
contestNote: Noroeste's weekly close-out report (Sep 21, 2026) cites a cumulative tally of 3,879 violent deaths and 4,424 persons deprived of liberty in Sinaloa since Sep 9, 2024 — up from 3,874 through Sep 18. The week ending Sep 20 recorded 25 violent deaths, down 31% from the prior week; September's projected total stands near 150. Separately, Infobae reports Sinaloa ranked 4th nationally in intentional homicides Jan–Aug 2026 (866 cases, 7.5% of the national total), behind Guanajuato, Baja California and Chihuahua, even as its daily average fell 26.1% year-over-year (2025 vs 2026) — a discrepancy researchers attribute to undercounting of conflict-linked disappearances as homicides. NGO Sabuesos Unidas: ~5,800 disappearances since Sep 2024. Official SNSP data remains lower than independent tallies.
